user.title: IR Remote HVAC - Emitter
user.description: Give the device a name and select the IR emitter entity that will transmit commands to the AC unit.

brand.title: IR Remote HVAC - Brand
brand.description: Select the HVAC brand, then choose the matching model.

model.title: IR Remote HVAC - Model
model.description: Select the model or remote that matches your HVAC unit.

temp_step.title: IR Remote HVAC - Temperature Step
temp_step.description: Choose the temperature step supported by your selected model.

reconfigure.title: IR Remote HVAC - Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the device name and IR emitter, then select the HVAC brand and model.

abort.no_emitters: No IR emitter entities are available. Please set up an emitter integration (e.g. ESPHome or Broadlink) first.
abort.pyhvac_not_installed: The pyhvac library is not installed. Check your Home Assistant installation.

error.invalid_brand: The selected HVAC brand is not recognised.
error.invalid_model: The selected model is not available for this brand.
error.invalid_temp_step: The selected temperature step is not supported for this model.

init.title: IR Remote HVAC - Options
init.description: Adjust the temperature range, step size, optional temperature/humidity/power sensors, and send debounce delay.

error.invalid_temp_range: Minimum temperature must be less than maximum temperature.
error.invalid_temp_step: The selected temperature step is not supported for this model.

legacy_device_migration.message: The saved device cannot be migrated automatically. Reconfigure the entry and select its brand and model.

legacy_device_migration.title: Reconfigure {name} after the pyhvac upgrade
legacy_device_migration.description: The saved device for {name} could not be migrated automatically to pyhvac 0.2. Open Settings > Devices & services > IR Remote HVAC, select Reconfigure from this entry's menu, and choose the correct HVAC brand and model or remote. The integration cannot start until this is resolved. After reconfiguring, verify that your HVAC works as expected.

external_entity_unavailable.title: Configured external entity unavailable
external_entity_unavailable.description: The configured %(role)s (%(entity_id)s) is unavailable or missing. Check that the source integration/device is online, or update IR Remote HVAC options to select another entity.
